Privacy Policy

Last updated: 9 October 2026

At Nookaa, we care about the drinks we serve and the people we serve them to. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect when you use the Nookaa app, website and outlets (together, the “Platform”), why we collect it, and the choices you have. Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (“DPDP Act”), Nookaa is the Data Fiduciary and you are the Data Principal.

This policy is issued in line with the DPDP Act and the DPDP Rules, 2025, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules made under it, and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

On this page

  1. Information we collect
  2. How we use your information
  3. Drink suggestions
  4. Your choices
  5. Who we share information with
  6. Where your information is stored
  7. How long we keep it
  8. Your rights
  9. Keeping your data safe
  10. Data breaches
  11. Children
  12. Cookies
  13. Changes to this policy
  14. Contact and grievances

1. Information we collect

  • Account details: your mobile number (required, verified by OTP) and email address (optional).
  • Order details: outlet, drinks ordered, customisations such as size, milk, sugar and ice, order notes, and your order history.
  • Membership and rewards details: your Membership Pack and its usage, Nooks earned and redeemed, Nookaa Money balance, cashback and coupons used.
  • Payment details: transaction reference, amount, payment method type and status. Card, UPI and bank details are handled by our licensed payment partners; Nookaa never sees or stores them.
  • App activity (only with your consent): drinks you view, items added to cart but not ordered, searches, and how you use app features.
  • Device details: device type, operating system, app version, IP address, notification token and crash reports.
  • Feedback: ratings, reviews and messages you send us.

We do not track your GPS location. We do not collect sensitive information such as health, biometric, religious or bank account details. If you mention an allergy or dietary need in an order note, we use it only to prepare that order.

2. How we use your information

  1. To create and secure your account.
  2. To take, prepare and serve your order, just the way you like it.
  3. To process payments, refunds and Membership Pack renewals.
  4. To run Nooks, cashback, coupons and your Nookaa Money.
  5. To send OTPs, order updates, receipts and renewal reminders.
  6. To help you when you contact support.
  7. To prevent fraud, coupon misuse and other abuse.
  8. To understand which drinks and features people enjoy, and to improve our menu and app (with your consent).
  9. To suggest drinks you might like in “Suggested for you” (with your consent).
  10. To tell you about new drinks, offers and items left in your cart by WhatsApp or app notification (with your consent).
  11. To meet tax, accounting and other legal requirements.

We use your data either with your consent or for a legitimate use allowed under Section 7 of the DPDP Act, for example when you give us your number to place an order. We will not use your data for a new purpose without telling you first.

3. Drink suggestions

“Suggested for you” shows drinks based on your past orders, your preferences and what’s popular. Over time we may make these suggestions smarter using your order history and app activity, and we will update this policy before doing so. Suggestions only change the order in which drinks appear. They never change prices. You can switch them off at any time in the app’s privacy settings.

4. Your choices

We ask for your consent separately for app analytics, personalised suggestions, WhatsApp offers and promotional notifications. None of these is switched on by default. You can change them at any time in the app’s privacy settings, reply STOP to any WhatsApp message, or turn off notifications on your phone. You can still order normally if you say no. Service messages such as OTPs, order updates, receipts and renewal reminders will always be sent.

5. Who we share information with

We never sell your personal data. We share it only when needed, with:

  • payment partners licensed under Reserve Bank of India rules, to process payments, refunds and Membership Pack renewals;
  • technology service providers that host our app and data, send OTPs and messages, deliver notifications and help us understand app performance;
  • government authorities, when required by law or a court order;
  • a successor business, if Nookaa is merged, acquired or restructured.

All service providers may use your data only to provide their service to Nookaa, under contracts that require them to keep it confidential and secure.

6. Where your information is stored

Your information is stored on secure cloud servers. If any data is processed outside India, we do so only as permitted under the DPDP Act and with appropriate safeguards.

7. How long we keep it

We keep your account information while your account is active and erase it after you delete your account. Order, payment, membership and Nookaa Money records are kept for up to 8 years as required by tax and accounting laws. App activity data is deleted or anonymised once it is no longer needed. Security logs are kept for at least one year as required by law. We will give you at least 48 hours’ notice before erasing an inactive account.

8. Your rights

You can:

  • see a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we use it;
  • correct or update your information;
  • delete your account and ask us to erase your data, unless we must keep it by law;
  • withdraw any consent you have given;
  • nominate someone to exercise these rights on your behalf in case of death or incapacity;
  • raise a complaint with us and, if it is not resolved, with the Data Protection Board of India.

You can do this through the app’s settings or Help & Support. To delete your account, see how to delete your account. We will respond within the time required by law.

9. Keeping your data safe

We use reasonable security safeguards, including encryption, OTP login, restricted staff access and regular backups. Never share your OTP with anyone; Nookaa staff will never ask for it.

10. Data breaches

If a data breach affects your personal data, we will inform you promptly and report it to the Data Protection Board of India and CERT-In as required by law.

11. Children

Nookaa accounts are for people aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18 without verifiable parental consent, and we never track or send targeted offers to children. If we learn that a minor has created an account, we will delete it.

12. Cookies

Our website uses essential cookies to work properly and, only if you agree, analytics cookies. You can manage cookies through the cookie banner or your browser settings.

13. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on the Platform, and we will notify you in the app of any significant changes.

14. Contact and grievances

For privacy questions, requests or complaints, contact us through Help & Support in the Nookaa app. The name and contact details of our Grievance Officer are displayed in the app and on our website. We will acknowledge your complaint within 48 hours and aim to resolve it within 30 days.

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: 9 October 2026

Welcome to Nookaa. These Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) apply when you use the Nookaa app, website or outlets (the “Platform”). They are an electronic record under the Information Technology Act, 2000. By creating an account, ordering, buying a Membership Pack, using a coupon, or earning or redeeming Nooks, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy.

On this page

  1. About Nookaa
  2. Your account
  3. Our drinks
  4. Ordering at our outlets
  5. Prices and payment
  6. Refund policy
  7. Membership Pack
  8. Nooks

  12. At our outlets
  13. Reviews and feedback
  14. Using the Platform

1. About Nookaa

Nookaa is a beverage brand that crafts and serves its own non-alcoholic drinks at Nookaa outlets in Mumbai. Nookaa operates as a grab-and-go brand serving beverages only. Orders are collected at the outlet counter for takeaway; we do not offer delivery. Any seating is limited and temporary, for a brief stop. Nookaa prepares every drink on its menu and is responsible for its quality and food safety under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Your account

  • You must be 18 or older to create an account.
  • You sign in with your mobile number and an OTP. Adding an email address is optional.
  • You are responsible for all activity on your account. Never share your OTP.
  • One account per person. Fake, duplicate or misused accounts may be suspended.

3. Our drinks

  • Made fresh: every drink is prepared to order and is best enjoyed straight away. Please consume it at the outlet soon after it is served.
  • Customisation: you can choose options such as size, milk, sweetness and ice where offered. Taste, colour and appearance may vary slightly between servings because drinks are handmade.
  • Ingredients and allergens: ingredient and allergen information is shown on the menu where available. Our drinks may contain or come into contact with milk, nuts, soy, gluten or other allergens. If you have an allergy, please speak to our staff before ordering.
  • Caffeine: some drinks contain caffeine. They may not be suitable for pregnant or breastfeeding women, people sensitive to caffeine, or children.
  • Hot drinks: hot beverages are served very hot. Please handle them with care.
  • Menu changes: drinks, ingredients, seasonal specials and prices may change, and items may sometimes be unavailable.
  • Images: menu photos are for illustration and may differ from the drink served.

4. Ordering at our outlets

  1. Select your outlet in the app, choose your drinks and pay.
  2. Your order is accepted when the app shows “Order accepted”. From that point we start preparing it.
  3. If we cannot fulfil your order, we will cancel it and refund you in full.
  4. Collect your drinks at the outlet counter. We do not offer table service or table reservations.
  5. Outside food and beverages are not allowed at our outlets.

5. Prices and payment

  • All prices are in Indian Rupees and include applicable GST. You will see the full amount before you pay.
  • Nookaa does not charge any platform fee, convenience fee or service charge. Tips are optional.
  • Payments are processed by licensed payment partners. Nookaa does not store your card, UPI or bank details.
  • If a price is shown incorrectly because of an obvious error, we may cancel the order and refund you in full.
  • You will receive a digital receipt for every order.

6. Refund policy

Situation Refund
You cancel before the order is accepted Full refund
You cancel after the order is accepted No refund, as your drink is already being prepared
We cancel your order or an item is unavailable Full refund for those items
Wrong drink, missing item, spilled or spoiled drink Tell our staff or report it in the app before you leave the outlet. We will remake the drink or refund it.
Order paid for but not served Full refund
Payment deducted but order not placed Automatic refund
  • A change of mind about taste or customisation after a drink has been correctly prepared is not eligible for a refund.
  • Refunds go to your original payment method, usually within 5–7 working days, or instantly to your Nookaa Money if you choose.
  • If an order paid partly with a coupon, Nooks or Nookaa Money is refunded, the amount you paid is refunded to its source. Nooks used are returned to your account. A coupon is restored only if it is still valid.
  • Cashback earned on a refunded order will be reversed.
  • This policy does not affect your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

7. Membership Pack

The Nookaa Membership Pack gives you drink benefits for a fixed period, as described in the app.

  • Benefits: the price, benefits, validity, eligible drinks, eligible outlets and daily usage limits are shown in the app before you buy.
  • Activation: your Membership Pack starts as soon as your payment is successful.
  • Personal use: a Membership Pack is linked to one account and is for your use only. It cannot be shared, transferred, resold or used to order for others unless the pack says otherwise.
  • Usage: benefits must be used at the outlet in person. Unused daily or monthly benefits do not carry forward and cannot be exchanged for cash.
  • Auto-renewal: if you choose auto-renewal, your pack renews automatically at the end of each period. You will be notified before each renewal charge.
  • Cancelling: you can turn off auto-renewal at any time in the app, in just a few taps. Your benefits continue until the end of the period you have already paid for.
  • Refunds: Membership Pack fees are not refundable once the pack period has started, except where required by law, if we cannot provide the benefits, or as stated in the app at the time of purchase.
  • Changes: if we change the price or benefits of a pack, we will tell you before your next renewal so that you can choose whether to continue. Changes never apply to a period you have already paid for.
  • Misuse: we may suspend or cancel a Membership Pack without refund if it is shared, resold or misused.

8. Nooks

Nooks are Nookaa’s reward points.

  • Earning: you earn Nooks on eligible paid orders and activities, at the rates shown in the app. Nooks are credited once your order has been served.
  • Redeeming: Nooks can be redeemed for drinks, discounts or other rewards shown in the app.
  • No cash value: Nooks have no cash value. They cannot be sold, transferred to another account or exchanged for money.
  • Expiry: Nooks may expire after the period shown in the app. We will remind you before they expire where possible.
  • Refunded orders: if an order is refunded or cancelled, any Nooks earned on it will be removed. Nooks you used on that order will be returned.
  • Account closure: unused Nooks lapse when your account is deleted.
  • Misuse: Nooks earned through fraud, fake orders, multiple accounts or abuse of the programme will be cancelled.
  • Changes: we may change earning rates, rewards or the Nooks programme with prior notice in the app. Nooks you have already earned remain usable until their stated expiry.

9. Coupons and offers

  • One per order: only one coupon can be applied per order unless the offer says otherwise.
  • Conditions: each coupon has its own conditions, such as minimum order value, eligible drinks, outlets, days, times and a maximum discount. These are shown with the coupon.
  • Validity: coupons are valid only during the stated period and cannot be extended.
  • Personal and non-transferable: coupons sent to you are for your account only, unless marked as shareable. They cannot be sold or exchanged for cash.
  • Combining offers: unless stated otherwise, coupons cannot be combined with other coupons, offers, or Membership Pack benefits.
  • Membership Pack purchases: coupons cannot be used on Membership Pack purchases unless the coupon says so.
  • Refunded orders: if an order is refunded, the coupon is restored only if it is still valid. Its value is never paid out as cash.
  • Misuse: we may cancel coupons and related orders, and suspend accounts, if coupons are misused, for example through multiple accounts, automated tools or sharing personal codes publicly.
  • Changes: we may modify or withdraw any offer at any time, but this will not affect orders already placed.

10. Cashback and Nookaa Money

  • Cashback is credited to your Nookaa Money after a qualifying order is served. It is reversed if the order is refunded.
  • Your Nookaa Money balance can only be used for Nookaa orders and Membership Packs. It cannot be withdrawn as cash or transferred to another person.
  • Money you add to Nookaa Money is refunded to your original payment method if you delete your account.
  • Cashback and promotional credit have no cash value, are non-refundable and may expire as shown in the app.
  • We may temporarily freeze your Nookaa Money if we suspect fraud or misuse.

11. Referrals

You may earn rewards for inviting friends to Nookaa, as described in the app. Rewards are given only for genuine new users. Self-referrals, fake accounts and spam will lead to rewards being cancelled.

12. At our outlets

  • Please treat our team and other guests with respect. We may refuse service to anyone who is abusive, unsafe or disruptive. Any accepted order will then be refunded.
  • Any seating is small and temporary and intended for a brief stop. Our outlets are not designed for extended stays, work or study sessions.
  • Please keep our outlets clean and do not damage furniture or equipment.
  • Smoking, vaping and alcohol are not allowed inside our outlets.
  • Nookaa is not responsible for personal belongings left unattended.

13. Reviews and feedback

Reviews must be honest and based on your own experience. We do not publish fake or paid reviews. By posting a review, you allow Nookaa to display it on the Platform. Ideas or feedback you share may be used to improve our drinks and services, without any obligation to you.

14. Using the Platform

You must not break the law, place fake orders, post offensive or unlawful content, impersonate others, or attempt to hack, copy or disrupt the app or website. We may suspend or close accounts that do so.

15. Intellectual property

The Nookaa name, logo, the name Nooks, drink names, recipes, menu designs, photos, app and website belong to Nookaa. You may not copy or use them without our written permission.

16. Limitation of liability

The Platform is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. To the extent the law allows, Nookaa is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, and our total liability for any order is limited to the amount paid for that order. Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be excluded by law.

17. Indemnity

You agree to compensate Nookaa for any loss caused by your breach of these Terms, your violation of law or your infringement of another person’s rights.

18. Closing your account

You can delete your account at any time from the app’s settings. When you do, Membership Pack auto-renewal is cancelled, money you added to Nookaa Money is refunded, and unused Nooks, cashback, coupons and promotional credit lapse. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these Terms. For the steps, see how to delete your account.

19. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time and will notify you of significant changes in the app. If you continue to use the Platform after an update, you accept the revised Terms.

20. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Please contact us first so we can try to resolve any concern. You may also contact the National Consumer Helpline (1915) or file a complaint with the appropriate Consumer Commission. Subject to your rights as a consumer, the courts in Mumbai, Maharashtra have exclusive jurisdiction.

21. Contact and grievances

For help or complaints, contact us through Help & Support in the Nookaa app. The name and contact details of our Grievance Officer are displayed in the app and on our website. We will acknowledge your complaint within 48 hours and aim to resolve it within one month.

22. General

If any part of these Terms is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect. Our failure to enforce a right is not a waiver of it. These Terms, together with our Privacy Policy, are the entire agreement between you and Nookaa.
